exposure: Immediate post-placental intrauterine contraceptive copper device (IUD) insertion (10 minutes after delivery of the placenta)
Interval intrauterine contraceptive copper device (IUD) insertion (6 weeks following delivery)
cohort: The study included 66 women undergoing caesarean delivery, evenly divided into two groups.
finding: Immediate post-placental IUD insertion in women undergoing caesarean delivery showed comparable complication, expulsion, and displacement rates to interval IUD insertion at 6-week and 3-month follow-up.
mod_finding: Post-placental IUD insertion is a safe and attractive postpartum contraception option for women undergoing elective caesarean section.
